data.description:
## Context

The `Verify Authorship Identity` CI gate (`.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml`) fails closed
when the blobless CI-checkout pack of the `tickets` branch exceeds
`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` (today `102400` = 100 MiB, a deliberate growth canary from commit
`16a1a385` / ticket `037b`). The pack is currently ~481 MiB, so the gate is RED (bug
`defensive-buckskin-rhino` / `a453-193b-2864-451b`).

The proof on parent epic `536b-8930-b922-4063` establishes that the ONLY lever that shrinks this
blobless pack is reducing reachable commit+tree objects via causal-stability history collapse, and
that even maximal SAFE coalescing (N=30d horizon) lands at ~365-380 MiB — it cannot reach 100 MiB
without an unsafe <4-day horizon. Therefore a temporary budget-raise bridge is unavoidable to get
the health lane green while the reclaim mechanism + structural fixes (W1 batch write lane, W2 root
tree shard) land.

## Scope of THIS ticket (the bridge, this change only)

Raise `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` from `102400` (100 MiB) to `563200` (550 MiB) — ~70 MiB
headroom over today's 481 MiB pack — and add a self-documenting comment immediately above the
value that names the restore ticket (`fluorspar-comparable-zeren` / `0894-b9b8-6590-4904`) so the
bridge is reversible and traceable. This is a temporary, deliberately-reversible loosening of the
canary, NOT a permanent budget change; the restore is tracked separately.

## Out of scope

The history-reclaim mechanism (S0-S3), W1/W2 structural fixes, and the eventual restore to 100 MiB
are separate tickets under the epic. This ticket does no history rewrite and no prod mutation of
the `tickets` branch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` in `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` is set to `563200`.
- [ ] A comment immediately above the value marks it as a TEMPORARY bridge and names restore ticket `fluorspar-comparable-zeren` (`0894-b9b8-6590-4904`).
- [ ] The fail-closed pack-size guard logic is otherwise unchanged (only the threshold value and the comment change).
- [ ] The commit carries a `rebar-ticket:` trailer for this ticket and a DCO sign-off.
- [ ] The change is pushed to Gerrit for review (`LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`) and is NOT self-submitted.

## Portability

`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` is a plain workflow environment variable consumed by a POSIX
`bash`/`git count-objects` guard; changing its value introduces no dependence on any single CI
provider and no new capability. The `project.portability` criterion is satisfied because the guard
remains a provider-agnostic shell check whose only input is a git object count.
data.title: W3 bridge: raise verify-identity pack budget to 550 MiB while 536b reclaim lands
